mapper.sql: select id, request_id, chain_name, success, code, message, execute_step_str, execute_step_str_with_time, steps_json, param_json, context_json, duration_ms, error_message, failed_node_id, create_by, create_time, webhook_url, webhook_status, webhook_attempts, webhook_http_status, webhook_message, webhook_time from lf_exec_log
mapper.insert: insert into lf_exec_log ( request_id, chain_name, success, code, message, execute_step_str, execute_step_str_with_time, steps_json, param_json, context_json, duration_ms, error_message, failed_node_id, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{requestId}, #{chainName}, #{success}, #{code}, #{message}, #{executeStepStr}, #{executeStepStrWithTime}, #{stepsJson}, #{paramJson}, #{contextJson}, #{durationMs}, #{errorMessage}, #{failedNodeId}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update lf_exec_log set webhook_url = #{webhookUrl}, webhook_status = #{webhookStatus}, webhook_attempts = #{webhookAttempts}, webhook_http_status = #{webhookHttpStatus}, webhook_message = #{webhookMessage}, webhook_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}

mapper.select: select count(*) as totalCalls, ifnull(sum(case when success = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successCount, ifnull(sum(case when success = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failCount, ifnull(round(avg(duration_ms)), 0) as avgDurationMs from lf_exec_log where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day)

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, count(*) as total, ifnull(sum(case when success = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successCount, ifnull(sum(case when success = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failCount from lf_exec_log where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by statDate

select chain_name as chainName, count(*) as total, ifnull(sum(case when success = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successCount, ifnull(sum(case when success = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failCount, ifnull(round(avg(duration_ms)), 0) as avgDurationMs from lf_exec_log where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) group by chain_name order by total desc limit 15

select chain_name as chainName, ifnull(error_message, message) as errorMessage, count(*) as count from lf_exec_log where success = 0 and create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) and ifnull(error_message, message) is not null and ifnull(error_message, message) != '' group by chain_name, ifnull(error_message, message) order by count desc limit 10

select id, chain_name as chainName, request_id as requestId, duration_ms as durationMs, date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from lf_exec_log where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) and duration_ms is not null order by duration_ms desc limit 10

select id, chain_name, execute_step_str_with_time, steps_json, create_time from lf_exec_log where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) and execute_step_str_with_time is not null and execute_step_str_with_time != '' order by id desc limit 2000
